text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Reporting for duty! I am Fenomeno!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Belongs to Miho Dorm and the Disciplinary 
Committee. Rank: Pre-debut!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with— ...Hm?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
What? A report? Right now, sir? 
Understood, I will keep it brief...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Not the "Soaked Washbasin Incident" 
again!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, not even thinking of the next person 
who'll use it—! I'll go question people! 
You restore things to how they were!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry! That will be all for 
today, so if you'll excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“—I'll be counting on you from now on! 
Boss!!”
"CASE: Stakeout"

A few days have passed since I signed on 
as Fenomeno's Trainer. Starting today, 
we're getting serious with training for 
her debut.
choice_data_list:
Let's start off with a 17-17 pace, shall 
we?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes! Running 1 furlong in 17 seconds!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Move out!!

With a smooth start, Fenomeno broke into a 
run at the exact pace instructed.
choice_data_list:
Knowledge: perfect, honesty: perfect, 
intuition: perfect...

text_block_list.text:
Watching her model-student running form 
straightens my spine. How much further she 
can grow all depends on me, her 
Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Cool-down complete!
choice_data_list: Good work, that was a wonderful run!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
No, it's all thanks to having a Boss who 
gives precise instructions.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Counting on that brilliant mind of yours!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I have a favor to ask of you!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your cooperation! To tell 
you the truth, this officer is facing a 
rather perplexing case.
choice_data_list: "A Baffling Case"..._!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...You, give me the intel.

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Apart from the 'Soaked Washbasin 
Incident' we resolved the other day, a 
letter was sent to the Disciplinary 
Committee.

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
"...We received a tip that an 'evil-eyed, 
vicious Umamusume' has been appearing near 
the Overseas Expedition Support Committee 
room."
choice_data_list: "A tip-off"... !?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. And this officer has identified 
a suspect.
choice_data_list: 'Hoshi'...!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
After asking around for the past few days, 
we've narrowed it down to about two 
suspects. The first one is—
choice_data_list: W-Wait a second! Fenomeno!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: What is it, Boss!
choice_data_list:
Is the Disciplinary Committee some kind of 
police force?

Is the Disciplinary Committee some kind of 
police force?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: No, that's not it!!

Meno-san, the way you speak is influenced 
by your father being a police officer, 
isn't it? ...Including referring to 
yourself as 'this officer.'

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes! My father is an ally of justice who 
helps the weak and crushes the strong! So 
I tried copying him—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: It's an adorable little story.
choice_data_list: Dream Journey!?

text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey is the intellectual 
chairwoman of the Expedition Support 
Committee. She is also a distinguished 
Umamusume who has won Grand Prix GⅠ races.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However... Meno-san. Did you come to the 
Expedition Support Committee Room to look 
for Or again?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Orfe-san is our prime suspect, 
after all.
choice_data_list:
...From the 'vicious-looking menacing 
Umamusume' incident?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes.

"Orfe"... The Umamusume named Orfevre is 
Dream Journey's younger sister.

Although still in the Classic tier, she is 
already showing glimpses of her talent... 
Apparently, some fans even revere her as a 
king.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I would greatly appreciate it if she would 
voluntarily agree to speak with me.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...After all, there have been reports of 
Umamusume bursting into tears just from 
locking eyes with her.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, regarding that room, we have 
information that an Umamusume not 
affiliated with any committee is using it 
as a hideout.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—I hear the academy's number one 
troublemaker, Gold Ship-san, visits quite 
often as well.

Gold Ship. She is a famous Umamusume at 
Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"She's quite adorable too, isn't she? Even 
if she's behind all the commotion."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, they come over to visit quite often. 
Orfevre has also permitted them to stay, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Boss. The prime suspects are the two 
listed above. Orfe-san and Golshi-san.
choice_data_list: I see...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ahem. Excuse me, Journey-senpai. Would you 
mind cooperating with our investigation?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
We would like to wait on standby in that 
room. Until they make their appearance—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: That is... difficult to say.
(Click)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, Journey-senpai!? Did you just lock 
it from the outside...?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
A staff member called for me in my role as 
class rep, so I was just locking up to 
leave.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I believe it would be best to reschedule 
for another day. ...You must all be 
exhausted after your training, right?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
That is certainly true... Be that as it 
may, however...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the report, Journey-senpai! 
I will wait right here!
choice_data_list:
Meno!? Did you hear what we were just 
talking about!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Sir! I was listening! However—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"If we push it off until tomorrow, the 
Umamusume who sent the letter will spend 
another day feeling anxious!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I want to solve this case as quickly as 
possible, even by a second, and bring her 
peace of mind without a moment's delay!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Golshi-san and the others might just 
wander by unexpectedly. I shall stand 
guard until then!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Still, if we can't secure a room, it's 
going to be a test of pure stamina from 
here on out."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Borrowing the Boss's wisdom will have to 
wait until tomorrow or later—
choice_data_list: No, I'll tag along too.
No, I'll join in too.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Kh!? Are you sure about this, Boss!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Guh... In the end, neither Orfe-san nor 
Golshi-san showed up...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry! Even though you came 
along with me, Boss...!
choice_data_list:
Don't apologize, I gained something 
valuable from this too.

Don't apologize, I gained something 
valuable from this too.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Harvesting?
choice_data_list:
That you're an Umamusume who fights for 
justice.

They say you're an Uma Musume who gives 
her all for justice,

text_block_list.text:
That time was also a great opportunity for 
me to get to know Fenomeno. And if I 
remember right—
choice_data_list:
Is that also the reason why you run in 
races?
That's why you run in races too, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...! Yes, I could never forget it!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“About that day, when I went from being a 
‘monster’ to a ‘champion of justice.’”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Even with this face, this build, and this 
personality... that used to do nothing but 
frighten the kids around me. Back when I 
ran in front of those children—

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
"Big sis, you're so cool!" "I want to try 
running like big sis too!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
As a leader... she was able to show them 
the way forward.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I thought that in a race, I could show the 
way— that I could even become an ally of 
justice.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Children are strongly influenced by the 
things they admire.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...If there is a noble, righteous role 
model for that admiration, the future is 
sure to be bright.
choice_data_list:
You're an Umamusume who wants to 
"protect," aren't you?

You're an Umamusume who wants to 
"protect," aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Protecting a bright and righteous 
future is the duty of an ally of justice!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I, too, am prepared to dedicate myself for 
the sake of the children and our juniors' 
future!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oho?

The next day. While waiting for Fenomeno 
in the Trainer's office...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Boss! Reporting in!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The culprit behind the "Mean-Eyed Menacing 
Umamusume" incident has been identified!!
choice_data_list: Oh, I'm glad that got resolved!
Oh, I'm glad that got resolved!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes! And so, the culprit is—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...It was none other than myself, sir!!
choice_data_list: ...What!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It seems the girl who sent the letter saw 
this officer on patrol in front of the 
Expedition Support Committee room...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
This is all due to my own lack of 
virtue...! I am terribly sorry...!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I have finished apologizing to everyone 
who was inconvenienced by my blunder. So 
Boss, please hand down my punishment—
choice_data_list: Expulsion!?

text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno's shoulders slumped visibly in 
defeat. Offering her words of 
encouragement, our journey in the Twinkle 
Series began.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—What are the Umamusume running in the 
Twinkle Series to everyone?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It's not something just anyone can become. 
That is why it commands respect, becomes a 
dream— and carries the hopes of all who 
yearn to be like them.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Those who run must be role models. Be 
righteous Umamusume worthy of being 
exemplary."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If an upstanding Umamusume becomes an 
inspiration for children, the world will 
become an even brighter place.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Through my racing, I shall contribute to 
the future of the children, sir!
